Zenith Explorers - Exploring Beyond Limits , Reaching Beyond Stars !

We are Zenith Explorers , a passionate team of curious minds , creative thinkers , and aspiring innovators united by our love for space , science , and technology . Our mission is to transform ideas into innovative solutions by using NASA's open data , scientific research , coding , and creativity to solve real world challenges on earth and beyond. We believe in teamwork , continuous learning , and thinking beyond boundaries.
